questions.question: Which TWO factors affect the cost of an Azure VM?

options.text: The colour of the portal theme

questions.explanation: Resource settings and geography affect price.

questions.question: Which type of network traffic is generally NOT charged?
questions.explanation: Ingress is generally free; egress is charged.

questions.question: After deleting VMs, your storage costs remain high. What is the most likely cause?

options.why: Free for built-in policies on Azure resources.

questions.explanation: Maintenance matters: clean up leftover resources.
